mode_inference_decision.rationale: A fully opaque tileable material source used on the existing validated helmet surface. This is not a replacement model or a rendered helmet image.

alpha_policy: opaque material; no chroma key because every texel is surface data
geometry_policy: Exact preservation of all baseline geometry attributes, indices, skin weights, inverse bind matrices and node transforms. Material-only candidate, no topology or fit adjustment.
material_policy: Only team_helmet_shell changes. Preserve the existing material slot and gameplay team tint. Replace albedo, normal and MR maps; normalScale .35 to 1 and roughnessFactor to 1 are explicit material changes for the new source-derived maps, not scalar-preservation claims. Metallic remains zero. Nonmetallic matte composite coating, subtle albedo mottling and restrained microrelief. No fabricated baked contact shadows or large scratches.
allowed_postprocess: source-derived height/normal and roughness mapping with documented parameters
qa_gates: all non-helmet material maps and settings exact
no seam or oversized grain at combat distance
